item.summary: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

item.title: 4 dead after US refueling aircraft goes down in western Iraq
item.summary: Four U.S. military members have been killed when their refueling aircraft "went down" in friendly airspace in western Iraq, according to U.S. Central Command.

item.title: WATCH: Israel continues striking Beirut as fighting intensifies
item.summary: ABC News' Matt Rivers reports from Beirut as the fighting between Israel and Hezbollah intensifies.

item.title: Synagogue ramming probed as targeted act of violence against Jewish community: FBI
item.summary: A suspect is dead after a shooting and vehicle ramming incident at a synagogue in West Bloomfield, Michigan, law enforcement sources told ABC News.

item.title: WATCH: How active shooter training helped thwart Michigan synagogue attack
item.summary: Retired FBI agent Brad Garrett discusses how an active shooter training in January helped prepare the West Bloomfield, Michigan, synagogue on how to respond to Thursday's vehicle ramming incident.

item.title: WATCH: Sneak-peak at the performances at the Oscars
item.summary: "GMA's" Lara Spencer spoke with Mandy Moore, an Emmy award-winning choreographer, for a preview of the big performances at the Oscars.

item.title: US weather to go nuts with blizzard, polar vortex, heat dome, atmospheric river
item.summary: The United States is getting slammed by a stretch of weather extremes, from flooding rain to record heat and late-season snow

item.title: WATCH: David Muir shares moment high school hockey player scores goal sending team to finals
item.summary: Nearly a month after his family was killed at his high school hockey game by a former family member, Colin Dorgan scored a double-overtime goal sending his team to the state title game.

item.title: WATCH: No deal in Homeland Security shutdown talks
item.summary: Travelers looking to escape for spring break are encountering long security lines and more widespread travel problems as the latest partial government shutdown drags on.

item.title: WATCH: Animal shelter rescues kitten who appeared inflated like a balloon
item.summary: A California animal shelter been treating a kitten, named Zoe, who was found appearing inflated like a balloon. ABC News' Danny New has the story.
